answer: Cross-Epoch Identity Continuity. Each identity’s behaviour is summarized per epoch as a fingerprint (interaction graph, timing, and coarse action mix). Across epochs, the system requires the ivory of stable continuity: a new epoch’s fingerprint must correlate with the prior one within tolerance. Agents whose histories wander outside that band lose standing and are throttled to low-trust actions. To pass, an attacker must run each sock identity through real behavioural drift over many epochs, and any slip of the pulse resets continuity,
